claims.text: NAFLD is associated with increased overall mortality compared to general population controls.
NAFLD is associated with a two-fold increased risk of diabetes.
NASH is associated with higher liver-related mortality compared to simple steatosis.
NASH with advanced fibrosis is associated with an odds ratio of 10.06 for liver-related mortality compared to simple steatosis.
NASH does not show a statistically significant increase in cardiovascular mortality compared to simple steatosis.
Cytokeratin-18 has a pooled AUROC of 0.82 for differentiating NASH from simple steatosis.
NAFLD fibrosis score achieves a pooled AUROC of 0.85 for identifying NASH with advanced fibrosis.
Fibroscan achieves a pooled AUROC of 0.94 for identifying NASH with advanced fibrosis.

methodologies.name: Systematic review and meta-analysis using random- or fixed-effects models
methodologies.description: Systematic literature search and meta-analysis of studies evaluating the natural history of NAFLD and the diagnostic accuracy of non-invasive tests compared against liver biopsy.
conditions: 40 articles assessing natural history of NAFLD included
32 articles evaluating non-invasive tests against liver biopsy included

limitations.text: The natural history of NAFLD and the optimal strategy to identify subjects with progressive liver disease are unclear.
